meta.title: No second award can be started while one is in approval
gaps: The expected refusal message is not checked because starting a new award is modeled as an accepted product action.
the case reads as “it is refused”, but the plan checks “it is accepted”

words.preconditions: A fresh RFQ event the QA vendor bid on, closed, and awarded to that vendor (award submitted for approval).
steps: The buyer opens an award proposal.
As the buyer, read the event and check that the event carries the award proposal.
words.expected: The app accepts it. Read back afterwards: the event carries the award proposal.

plan.title: No second award can be started while one is in approval

assert.say: the event carries the award proposal
